title: Mirror Greg's 2026-09-30 word on blocking findings into TermAl's standing rule: Notes and trivial Lows no longer block a landing, Medium and higher must be fixed
outcome: TermAl's standing commit rule in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md says which review findings block a landing as Greg decided on 2026-09-30: Medium and higher must be fixed and reviewed again; a Low need not be fixed and may be filed for later; a Note never blocks.
acceptance: Greg was sent the exact wording and its consequence before the landing, and no objection from him is recorded.

The Commit and push section of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md cites Greg's words of 2026-09-30 verbatim with their source, and states which findings block a landing, in wording that both coordinators concurred on word for word in recorded messages.
The agent-command tests pin the new wording in both files, and the two files' Commit and push sections stay identical.
The final-diff audit is recorded on the item as passed before the landing, by the coordinator who did not write the change.
The full gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding finding that blocks under the rule in force when the pair runs.

completion.summary: TermAl's standing commit rule in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md now blocks a landing only on in-scope findings of Medium or higher. A Low or a Note need not be fixed, and an unfixed Low is filed as its own item; the rule cites Greg's 2026-09-30 words with their source. /fix-bug Step 5 matches: Critical, High and Medium are fixed; a Low is filed, or fixed and re-gated and re-reviewed. An agent-command test pins the wording. Landed as bf216ee: gate test-301fd307, review round 2 with nothing of Medium or higher, (a) both coordinators concurred, (b) Greg was sent the final wording before the landing, (c) the final-diff audit passed by Engram::Fable. The acceptance evaluation passed all five criteria.
